question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 5.
solution:
The correct answer is **"explained."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Explained"** means to make something clear or easy to understand by describing or giving information about it. (समझना, स्‍पष्‍ट करना)

 
 
• **Example: ***She **explained**__ how I should fill in the form.*
 
 
 
• This option fits the context of the sentence, as it suggests that someone provided an explanation for something.
 
• The verb is in the past tense, which matches the tense of the other verbs in the sentence.
 
• The correct answer is Option 1.
 
• Correct passage:

When he was in college, a famous poet made a useful distinction for him. He had drunk __enough__ in the poet's company to be compelled to describe to him a poem he was __thinking__ of. It would be a monologue of sorts, the self-contemplation of a student on a summer afternoon who is reading Euphuise. The poem itself would be a subtle __series__ of euphuisms, translating the heat, the day, the student's concerns, into symmetrical posies; translating even his __contempt__ and boredom with that famously foolish book into a euphuism.

The poet nodded his big head in a sympathetic, rhythmic way as this was __**explained**__ to him, then told him that there are two kinds of poems. There is the kind you write; there is the kind you talk about in bars. Both kinds have value and both are poems; but it's fatal to confuse them. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **"Sprang"** means to jump up quickly or suddenly. (तेज़ी से उछलना या छलाँग मारना)
 
• **"Theorised"** means to form a theory or speculative explanation about something. (किसी चीज़ के बारे में एक सिद्धांत या अनुमानात्मक व्याख्या तैयार करना)
 
• **"Raised"** means to lift something up or cause something to be higher. ((कुछ) ऊपर उठाना)
